readout_other: Motivational Go/NoGo learning task with reinforcement-learning model parameters (response, learning and persistence biases)
direction_notes: TUS to the aIns reduced the Pavlovian learning bias and TUS to the dACC increased the persistence bias; both increased overall Go bias and persistence. The authors say the direction of the neural effect could not be determined.
safety_notes: Side-effect questionnaires on the day and 12-48 hours later: mild to moderate anxiety, sleepiness, headache, neck pain and similar after both active and sham sessions; one participant reported a mild vision problem possibly related to stimulation.

device.model: CTX-500 NeuroFUS TPO, four-element annular transducer

timing.protocol_description: 5 Hz-patterned protocol with a 10% duty cycle (500 kHz, 20 ms pulses, pulsed every 200 ms), applied for 80 s (400 pulses in total), delivered to the left then the right hemisphere for the bilateral aIns; the Go/NoGo task started within 10 min of the end of sonication.
